column1: # P20: the models each VRAM tier is measured on, every engine on the same GPU (scripts/consumer_bench.sh; benchmarks/consumer/README.md).
# tier_gb: the GPU memory class the row is measured on (8, 12, 16, 24 or 32). model: the Hub repo (its family's current release; released: its date).
# params_b: its parameters, in billions (which model is the largest). glyd: the level Glyd runs it at. gguf: the llama.cpp quant of the same
# weights at about the same bits, QUANT or QUANT@REPO where it is made from another checkpoint of the model (Google's QAT one for gemma's wren);
# the same GGUF file is what Ollama and LM Studio are given. A row's gguf "-" has no llama.cpp side.
